# LinkX

> LinkX is India's affiliate marketing and creator monetization platform, connecting creators, influencers, and publishers with 500+ top brands to earn commissions by sharing product links.

LinkX lets creators generate trackable affiliate links for popular Indian brands (Myntra, boAt, MakeMyTrip, Amazon.in, and more), track clicks and conversions from a dashboard, and withdraw commissions directly to a UPI ID or bank account. The platform is free to join with no minimum follower requirement.

## Main Pages

- [Home](https://cloudlinks.in/): Overview of the LinkX creator monetization platform and how to start earning.
- [Campaigns](https://cloudlinks.in/campaigns): Browse all active brand affiliate campaigns and their commission rates.
- [How It Works](https://cloudlinks.in/how-it-works): Step-by-step explanation of the LinkX affiliate link and payout process.
- [Influencer Program](https://cloudlinks.in/influencer): Details on the influencer partnership program and creator tiers.
- [Payouts](https://cloudlinks.in/payouts): Payout methods, minimum thresholds, and withdrawal process.
- [Top Brands](https://cloudlinks.in/top-brands): Directory of the highest-earning partner brands on LinkX.
- [Categories](https://cloudlinks.in/categories): Browse affiliate campaigns by product category.
- [Earning Tips](https://cloudlinks.in/earning-tips): Strategies and tips for creators to maximize their affiliate earnings.
- [Blog](https://cloudlinks.in/blog): Articles and guides on affiliate marketing for Indian creators.
- [About Us](https://cloudlinks.in/about-us): LinkX's mission, story, and team.
- [Contact](https://cloudlinks.in/contact): Support and contact information.
- [FAQs](https://cloudlinks.in/faqs): Frequently asked questions about the platform.
